purpose: mechanically modularize the current Home coded-UX prototype without visual or behavioral change

extracted_asset.note: The large immutable PNG payload is not duplicated in work/. The build resolves it from the retained complete oracle and verifies its decoded identity.

modular_source.note: Untouched CSS/JS modules are exact block pointers. build.py can materialize a selected module before editing; materialized modules become deterministic overrides.

qualification.note: Because the generated standalone file is byte-identical to the retained oracle, its HTML/CSS/JS payload and browser input are exactly the same. A2 is a source-organization change only.
